proposed_comments.title: Preserve existing PasteFormats telemetry IDs
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve existing PasteFormats telemetry IDs

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPaste/Models/PasteFormats.cs` (`PasteFormats`).

**Suggested change:** Assign `PasteAsJpgFile` an explicit unused stable value instead of inserting it before the existing HTML and transcode values. These enum values are emitted directly in format-click and in-app-shortcut telemetry, so renumbering the following members makes existing dashboards and persisted numeric payloads interpret old actions as different formats. Keep display ordering separate from the persisted telemetry ID.

confidence.rationale: The enum members are used as telemetry values, and insertion before existing members changes their numeric identities.

proposed_comments.title: Normalize clipboard bitmaps before JPEG encoding
proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize clipboard bitmaps before JPEG encoding

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPaste/Helpers/TransformHelpers.cs` (`PasteAsJpgFileAsync`).

**Suggested change:** Convert the decoded clipboard bitmap to a JPEG-supported pixel format and define alpha compositing before calling `SetSoftwareBitmap`. `GetImageContentAsync()` can return valid grayscale or alpha-bearing images that the encoder cannot consume directly or cannot represent correctly. Add regression coverage for both a grayscale image and a transparent image.

confidence.rationale: The encoder path passes the decoded bitmap through without format normalization even though valid clipboard formats and JPEG alpha support differ.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve hotkey IDs for legacy settings
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve hotkey IDs for legacy settings

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI.Library/AdvancedPastePasteAsFileAction.cs` (`SubActions`).

**Suggested change:** Preserve the existing serialized positions with an explicit migration or native placeholder before inserting the JPEG action into displayed order. For an older settings file with no JPEG property, the Settings model creates the missing backing field while the native module can still enumerate only actions physically present in the legacy JSON; inserting the child in the middle can therefore assign HTML and later actions the wrong hotkey IDs until settings are rewritten.

confidence.rationale: The hotkey identity is positional across managed and native settings readers, and legacy JSON omits the newly introduced child.

proposed_comments.title: Hide disabled JPEG shortcuts
proposed_comments.body:
### Hide disabled JPEG shortcuts

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/ShortcutGuide/ShortcutGuide.Ui/Helpers/PowerToysShortcutsPopulator.cs` (`PopulateAdvancedPasteShortcuts`).

**Suggested change:** Guard the JPEG entry with `PasteAsJpgFile.IsShown` in addition to the parent Paste-as-file visibility. Advanced Paste checks both visibility levels when activating the action, so Shortcut Guide currently can advertise a shortcut that the user disabled.

confidence.rationale: The new Shortcut Guide entry checks only the parent group while the action has its own visibility setting.
